query: Someone has fly tipped a pile of waste on my private land and on the street in England. I want to report the fly tipping to the local council environmental health or waste team, or to the Environment Agency if the load is large or hazardous. If it is happening now I would contact the police. Who helps?
title: Fly tipping on my land or street: who helps

freeHelp.title: Report fly-tipping (GOV.UK)
freeHelp.blurb: Report fly tipping to your local council in England. The council investigates illegal dumping on public land and may arrange clearance. On private land the occupier often has to clear the waste, but you should still report it.

freeHelp.title: Environment Agency
freeHelp.blurb: Report serious environmental incidents in England, including large, organised or hazardous fly tipping. Use the incident line if the waste is harmful or on a large scale.

freeHelp.title: Contact the police (101 or 999)
freeHelp.blurb: Call 999 if a crime is happening now or someone is in danger. Call 101 to report a crime that is not an emergency, including fly tipping in progress.

freeHelp.title: Crimestoppers
freeHelp.blurb: Anonymous reporting line — not for emergency use (call 999 in immediate danger).

freeHelp.title: Victim Support
freeHelp.blurb: Free 24/7 support for victims and witnesses of crime — emotional and practical help.

freeHelp.title: Legal Aid Agency
freeHelp.blurb: Information on legal aid and finding a legal aid provider.

freeHelp.title: Citizens Advice Adviceline (England)
freeHelp.blurb: Free phone advice on consumer, debt, housing, employment and more — routes to local help.
